p: Euphrates: Because this river was far from Jerusalem, it is evident that this was a vision, by which it was signified that the Jews would pass over the Euphrates to be captives in Babylon, and there for length of time would seem to be rotten, although they were joined to the Lord before as a girdle about a man.
skin shall be filled with wine: Every one of you will be filled with spiritual drunkenness, and be without all knowledge to seek how to help yourselves.
dash them one against another: It will be as easy for me to destroy the greatest and the strongest as it is for a man to break earthen bottles.
darkness: That is, affliction and misery by the Babylonians, Isa 8:22.
light: Meaning, for help and support of the Egyptians.
weep in secret places for your: You will surely be led away captive and I, according to my affection toward you, will weep and lament for your stubbornness.
king and to the queen: For Jehoiachin and his mother rendered themselves by Jeremiah's counsel to the king of Babylon, 2Ki 24:12.
the south shall be shut up: That is, of Judah, which lies south of Babylon.
flock that was given thee: He asks the king, where his people is become.
taught them to be captains: By seeking to strangers for help, you have made them skilful to fight against you.
uncovered: The cloak of hypocrisy will be pulled off, and your shame seen.
that thy shame may appear: As your iniquities have been revealed to all the world, so shall your shame and punishment.
neighings: He compares idolaters to horses inflamed after mares.
the fields: There is no place so high nor low, where the marks and signs of your idolatry do not appear.
